reorder.label: Buy again
reorder.help: "Buy again" on a past order's page (and, when chosen, on its card in My orders) puts the order's items back in the bag at today's price, offers and stock. A sold-out size is shown with the sizes still in stock; a product no longer sold is named and left out; a set comes back as its set only while it is still offered. Nothing is ordered until the customer checks out. Off as it ships.
